Pin @types/react to 19.2.x (the one deliberate range in the repo)
Expo SDK 57 keeps TypeScript 6.x in native (TS 7 has no public API yet)
Expo owns its own version ranges — `expo install --fix` is the tool, not syncpack
Local workspace packages use the workspace:* protocol
